title: Beatrix and the Confession
author: Casper Blackwood
blurb: Odile Sandoval, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
